_comment: Casting for tools/tts/generate_voice.py. 'ref' names a synthetic clip in tools/tts/refs/ (<ref>_en.wav, or <ref>_hi.wav for Hindi and Urdu), made by make_refs.py from Kokoro voicepacks: never a recording of a real person. 'pace' multiplies the per-line pace in direction.json, 'pitch' is a semitone shift with formants preserved, 'fx' is an ffmpeg filtergraph applied to every line of that speaker.
